annotations.title: Currency conversion (ECB): amount from one currency into up to 10, any date since 1999

description: Use when you need to convert an amount between currencies (USD↔KRW, EUR→JPY, ...) at the official ECB reference rate, today or on a past date. Input: from, to (1–10 comma-separated), amount (default 1), optional date (YYYY-MM-DD since 1999-01-04; weekends use the prior fixing). Output: JSON per target rate, inverse rate and converted result, the fixing date used. Source: ECB statistics; reference only. Use instead: fx_rates for every ECB rate for one fixing with % change vs the prior fixing; fx_history for a date range. Example: ?from=USD&to=KRW,JPY&amount=250 Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

from.description: Source currency, ISO 4217 (one of the 30 ECB reference currencies)
